build_batch_reinforce_agent: build a BatchREINFORCE agent with an environment, policy, baseline, and learning rate
run_train_step: run a training step collecting N trajectories and updating the policy using VPG
train_from_paths: train the policy from collected trajectory paths using conjugate policy gradient surrogate
compute_cpi_surrogate: compute the constrained policy optimization surrogate loss from observations, actions, and advantages
process_paths: process trajectory paths to extract observations, actions, advantages, and return statistics
